comment: Email, call, voicemail and follow-up wording is generated in outreach.js (buildDraft, buildCallScript, buildFollowUp) so the desk and the card share one source of truth. This file keeps the invite URL, the review note, and category ids used to match payout-tier research estimates on the card. Do not put dollar ranges or the licensing company's name into scripts. Per-category rough payout estimates in config/payout-tiers.json are for the research card and list chips only — never copy them into email or call scripts.
reviewNote: Custom wording should go through DataEarners platform review before use; one business at a time; stop if asked.
optOutEmail: If this is not for you, reply "unsubscribe" and I will not email you again.
optOutCall: If this is not for you, just say so and I will not contact you again.
